_note: User-facing notes, newest first: the Today card after an update and the update window (scripts/release-notes.py) both read this file. Every release adds its version here; 1-3 items, each a short title and one or two plain sentences. action: settings:<pane> or page:<today|apps|log|automations>.

items.title: Safari stays tidy
items.detail: Hmunmawi's Safari reads (X, Zoho Mail, payouts, offer codes) now take turns, open their own tab and always close it again. X unfollows no longer stop for the day with "lost its tab".

items.title: Needs a look, not needs fixing
items.detail: Your scripts can now flag something to look at without calling it a failure. It shows amber, counts in the health pill, alerts once a day at most and clears when the script reports ok.

items.title: Live sales buttons open the right place
items.detail: Live sales is in Settings → General. The What's new buttons and messages about your worker now point there.

items.title: A new token when Cloudflare refuses the old one
items.detail: If Cloudflare refuses the token saved for your live-sales worker, Live sales says so and asks for a new one next to Update worker.

items.title: See what changed after each update
items.detail: After an update, Today shows what is new since the version you last used, once, with a button to each new screen. The update window shows the same notes before you install.

items.title: Worker updates with a one-account token
items.detail: Updating your live-sales worker now also works with a Cloudflare token that is limited to one account.

items.title: Your live-sales worker stays up to date
items.detail: When a new version changes the worker, Hmunmawi updates the one in your Cloudflare account by itself. Update worker in Live sales does it on demand.

items.title: Settings in groups, and Set up… for jobs
items.detail: The Settings sidebar is grouped like System Settings, and Settings → Jobs has a Set up… button for each job Hmunmawi can run for you.

items.title: Agents without a badge always ask
items.detail: Once you give your agents badges, one that sends no badge waits for your OK, even in Full Autopilot.

items.title: Clearer Today cards
items.detail: Worries are never green, the Money card says what its change measures, and the Health card's sentence matches its number.

start_here.title: Today is your daily answer
start_here.detail: One sentence each morning: what went well, what to watch and what to do next. Sample numbers show until your own arrive.

start_here.title: Connect your apps
start_here.detail: Settings → Connections: App Store Connect first, then any other source you use. Keys stay in your Keychain.

start_here.title: Let routines watch for you
start_here.detail: Automations runs checks on a schedule and asks before it changes anything outside Hmunmawi.
